test_title: SSC MTS (2022) Official Paper (Held On: 15 May, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Among four students sitting in a row, average age of last three students is 48 years and the average age of first three students is 50 years. If the age of first student is 56 years, then what is the age of the last student?
solution:
Given:

The total students are = 4

The average age of first three students = 50 years

The average age of last three students = 48 years

The age of first student = 56 years

Concept:

Average ={The sum of all itemsover The total number of items}

Calculation:

Let all student = x, y, z, p

According to the question

The sum of the age of the first three students

x + y + z = 3 × 50 = 150 years..........(1)

The sum of the age of the last three students

y + z + p = 3 × 48 = 144 years....(2)

Subtract 1 from 2.

x - p = 6

As age of x = 56

p = 56 - 6 = 50

∴ The required result will be 50 years.
